nc1fb6b69ca.headline: Putin instructed to regulate ICO, registration of miners, and the status of cryptocurrencies on RB.RU
nc1fb6b69ca.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin instructed the government and Central Bank to regulate ICOs, register cryptocurrency miners, and define the status of cryptocurrencies following a meeting on October 10.
nc1fb6b69ca.why: Russia's regulatory stance on cryptocurrencies affects the country's fintech sector and investor confidence in digital assets, impacting the broader crypto market.
